app_concept.vibe: Midnight Velvet & Bioluminescence - A secure, local vault for creative minds.
app_concept.archetype: Luxury Dark mixed with Technical Privacy

rules: Do not use Inter, Roboto, Lato, or Space Grotesk.
Use tight letter spacing for headings.
Chat text MUST use IBM Plex Sans with loose line-height (leading-relaxed) for long-form readability.
No gradients for backgrounds. Use solid tinted darks with noise textures.

layouts.sidebar: w-72 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-white/5 h-screen overflow-y-auto hidden md:flex flex-col p-6
layouts.main_pane: flex-1 flex flex-col h-screen relative bg-[#0A0A0B]
layouts.chat_container: flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 md:p-8 scroll-smooth pb-40
layouts.composer_container: absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 md:p-8 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0B] via-[#0A0A0B]/80 to-transparent
layouts.spacing_strategy: Use generous spacing. Chat messages should have gap-8 between them.

sidebar.instruction: Contains New Chat button, session list, and bottom footer with Storage indicator (progress bar) and Privacy Settings.

chat_header.instruction: Sticky top glassmorphic bar containing Tone Selector (Professional vs Story) and Model Picker (Dropdown). Add a 'Local Only' lock icon indicator.

message_composer.instruction: Floating dock style. Contains attachment button (image/video), textarea (auto-growing), and submit button. Above the textarea, a horizontal scrollable tray for image/video preview thumbnails (w-16 h-16 rounded-lg object-cover).

tone_selector.instruction: Use standard Select component but style the triggers. When 'Story' is selected, tint the trigger border with accent color #FFB000. When 'Professional', use #90E0EF.

storage_warning.instruction: When localStorage > 3.5MB, trigger a Sonner Toast with #FF3B30 destructive styling.

privacy_modal.instruction: Shadcn Dialog with intense backdrop-blur. Content explains that all data stays in browser.

motion.chat_entrance: Framer Motion: fade in and slide up (y: 10) for new messages.
motion.hover_states: All buttons must have distinct hover states (lighter background + text color change).
motion.transitions: Use specific transition properties, e.g., transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease. NO 'transition: all'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the constraints rigorously. The UI must feel like a premium, local vault.
Set up the layout using Flexbox/Grid ensuring the sidebar can toggle on mobile.
Implement base64 image/video logic cleanly without breaking UI states.
Ensure local storage logic uses proper try/catch for quota exceeded errors, linking to the Sonner Toast warning.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use Javascript (.js/.jsx) for Shadcn components, not TypeScript.
Include a subtle SVG noise/grain texture overlay fixed to the screen with pointer-events-none and 3% opacity.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds over scrolling content.
Do not use generic centered text alignment. Align everything to the left for standard reading flow.
Ensure contrast ratio is accessible (WCAG AA).
Never use HTML native inputs or selects. ONLY use Shadcn components.
Sonner component must be used for Toasts.
